commonObjections.angle: Reframe around cost of downtime, repeat fixes, or lost customers from a weak site/network — not the sticker price of doing it right once. Mention the free on-site assessment or bundle discounts where relevant.

commonObjections.objection: I need to think about it
commonObjections.angle: Uncover the real hesitation with a gentle open question, don't pressure

commonObjections.objection: We already have an in-house IT person / developer
commonObjections.angle: Position as augmenting their team for specialized or one-off projects, not replacing them

commonObjections.objection: I can just do this myself / use a template
commonObjections.angle: Respect it, then highlight the cost of a system that isn't built to scale or integrate with the rest of their operations

escalationRules.handOffMessage: I'm looping in a member of our team who can help with that directly — they'll be with you shortly!
